vanadyl sulphate (VOSO4) is an effective insulin sensitizer in diabetic rats and in humans, and that the mechanism of action is related to the ability of this metal to mimic the action of insulin on the tyrosine kinase activity of the insulin receptor.
vanadium and insulin concomitantly administered to diabetic rats, in a dose-dependent manner, modulated proinflammatory and anti-inflammatory biomarkers.
